rules.description: A source record entering evidence review must carry a confidentiality classification before any further processing.
rules.findingText: This source has no confidentiality classification. Unclassified material cannot be risk-routed, AI-routed, or used in training content.
rules.resolutionHint: Assign one of the seven license/confidentiality classifications before review proceeds.
limitations: Cannot verify the classification chosen is factually correct — only that one exists.

rules.description: Content classified BURRANA_PRIVATE or CUSTOMER_PRIVATE must never be routed to an external AI provider.
rules.findingText: An external AI routing request was made for restricted content. The request was blocked.
rules.resolutionHint: Confirm the block, review who initiated the request, and correct the workflow or classification if wrong.
limitations: Detects routing requests recorded by the host; cannot detect exfiltration outside the application.

rules.description: A source whose file hash matches an existing registered source should be linked, not processed as new evidence.
rules.findingText: This source is hash-identical to an existing registered source.
rules.resolutionHint: Link this upload to the existing source record and archive the duplicate.
limitations: Hash-identical only; near-duplicates are AI Assist suggestions, not kernel conditions.

rules.description: AI-assisted content cannot enter approval without traceable approved source spans.
rules.findingText: This AI-drafted content has no linked source spans. Ungrounded generated content cannot be approved for training.
rules.resolutionHint: Link the exact approved source passages the draft derives from, or reject the draft.
limitations: Verifies span links exist; cannot verify the spans semantically support every sentence.

rules.description: No content object may publish unless its status is APPROVED.
rules.findingText: A publication request was made for content not in APPROVED status. The request was blocked.
rules.resolutionHint: Route the content through review and approval, or reject it.
limitations: Status-based; assumes approval records themselves are controlled.

rules.description: A mandatory training assignment must link to a configured human approval record before issuance.
rules.findingText: A mandatory assignment was requested with no linked approval record.
rules.resolutionHint: Obtain and link the required approval before issuing the assignment.
limitations: Verifies the approval link exists, not that the approver held the correct role.

rules.description: When training is the only corrective action attached to the originating event, the intervention requires explicit justification.
rules.findingText: Training is the only corrective action for this event. Training alone rarely corrects process, tooling, or resource causes.
rules.resolutionHint: Complete the Appropriateness Review: confirm training is genuinely the primary control, or add the process/engineering control that is.
limitations: Counts linked controls in the host record; cannot judge whether those controls are adequate.

rules.description: An intervention requesting approval must have an Appropriateness Review confirming a competence or awareness gap.
rules.findingText: No competence or awareness gap is documented for this intervention.
rules.resolutionHint: Document the gap in the Appropriateness Review, or select a non-training intervention.
limitations: Verifies the review answer exists; cannot verify the gap analysis quality.

rules.description: An intervention cannot be approved without a defined effectiveness method and target level.
rules.findingText: This intervention defines no effectiveness method.
rules.resolutionHint: Define the effectiveness method, target level, owner, and observation period before approval.

rules.description: If the same HF theme + process combination was previously trained and the event recurred, another training cycle requires escalated justification.
rules.findingText: This theme and process were already trained within the recurrence window and the issue recurred.
rules.resolutionHint: Escalate: redesign the intervention, review the original causal analysis, or select a non-training control.
limitations: Depends on host-computed derived fields; window length is configuration (T1), not kernel logic.

rules.description: A Learning Atom derived from an event whose causal status is below VERIFIED must carry the interim-awareness label.
rules.findingText: This content presents causal factors that are not yet verified, without the required interim-awareness label.
rules.resolutionHint: Apply the label 'Interim preventive awareness content. Causal investigation remains open.' — or hold the atom until causal status is verified.
limitations: Label-presence check; cannot judge tone of the content body.

rules.description: Effectiveness closure requires evidence at the plan's target level. Completion (Level 1) never closes a plan targeting Level 2+.
rules.findingText: Closure was requested with completion-only evidence, but the plan requires a higher effectiveness level.
rules.resolutionHint: Record the required evidence (assessment, observation, or outcome data) before closure, or revise the plan with approval.
limitations: Level comparison only; evidence quality is human judgment.

rules.description: An open supervisor effectiveness observation past its due date requires attention.
rules.findingText: A supervisor effectiveness observation is overdue.
rules.resolutionHint: Complete the observation or re-plan it with an approved new due date.
limitations: Uses server-local midnight for date comparison.

rules.description: Frozen manifests are immutable; the database blocks modification. Any attempted modification event is surfaced for review.
rules.findingText: A modification was attempted on a frozen training-package manifest. The attempt was blocked.
rules.resolutionHint: Review who attempted the change and why. If content must change, issue a new package revision — never edit history.
limitations: Fires on host-reported attempts; DB constraints are the actual enforcement.
